in_sanskrit.name: Bisu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bisu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vaiṣvānara’ meaning the ‘Lord of Wealth’. In Hindu mythology, Vaiṣvānara is a form of Lord Vishnu, often depicted as the guardian of the world. The name Bisu is an abbreviated form of this deity name.
